title: Give every produced wagon artifact grammar-conformant contract and telemetry URNs

facts.note: Task wording about defining, changing or reviewing what a wagon produces or how its outputs are named.
Applies to authoring, modifying and reviewing wagon-produced artifacts alike; reviewing existing nonconforming outputs is in scope.

values: any file that defines or names a wagon-produced artifact (wagon manifest, plan document, WMBT/acceptance, contract or telemetry definition, implementation that declares produced artifacts or their URNs)
facts.note: The source does not restrict representation; whether a file defines a wagon-produced artifact or its URN must be judged from content, not from file kind alone.

values: wagon-produced artifact defined, modified or renamed
contract/telemetry URN introduced or modified anywhere
facts.note: Optional diff-level observer that detects produced-artifact declarations or contract:/telemetry: URN strings in any changed file; not required for activation.

values: wagon-produced artifact missing a contract or telemetry URN
facts.note: Detector over all wagon-produced artifacts (existing and new) that checks URN presence and grammar.

fires: Planner adds a new artifact to a wagon's produced outputs, in any representation.
Planner renames or restructures an existing produced artifact or its contract or telemetry URN.
Planner authors a new wagon that produces artifacts.
Planner reviews or audits an existing wagon whose produced artifacts may lack or misuse contract/telemetry URNs.
A plan, acceptance or implementation change defines a wagon-produced artifact or references/introduces its URN outside the wagon manifest.
doesNotFire: Work that does not concern any wagon-produced artifact or its contract/telemetry URNs (e.g. prose-only edits to a wagon description, WMBT wording that names no produced artifact).
Artifacts a wagon only consumes, when no produced artifact or its URN is defined, changed or reviewed.

given: A wagon produces, or is being planned to produce, one or more artifacts, in whatever file or document they are defined.
when: The planner defines, modifies or reviews any wagon-produced artifact or its contract/telemetry URN.
then: Give each produced artifact a contract URN of the form contract:{theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})? and a telemetry URN of the form telemetry:{theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})?, following the artifact-naming grammar.
prefer: Write both URNs for every produced artifact, using the same theme/category/aspect path segments so the contract and telemetry identities line up.
Use ':' to separate theme, zero or more categories, and aspect; use a single '.' only before an optional variant on the last segment.
avoid: Producing an artifact with only a contract URN or only a telemetry URN.
URNs without the 'contract:' / 'telemetry:' scheme prefix, with no theme or aspect, or with '.' used as a category separator.
Inventing ad-hoc naming shapes that the artifact-naming file mapping cannot resolve.
why: Contract URNs map to contract files and telemetry URNs map to the telemetry filesystem through the artifact-naming grammar; a URN outside that grammar breaks resolution for producers and consumers across wagon boundaries.
evidence: Every wagon-produced artifact, wherever it is defined, has both a contract URN and a telemetry URN.
Each contract URN matches contract:{theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})? and each telemetry URN matches telemetry:{theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})?.
verifier_detail: Term 'artifact_urn' = the contract/telemetry URN forms. contract_urn: contract:{theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})?; telemetry_urn: telemetry:{theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})?.
Valid examples from source (use as positive fixtures): 'contract:commons:ux:foundations:color', 'contract:mechanic:decision.choice', 'telemetry:commons:ux:foundations'.

Grammar notes: theme and aspect are required; categories repeat zero or more times separated by ':'; variant is optional and introduced by a single '.' on the final segment (e.g. 'decision.choice' = aspect 'decision', variant 'choice').
Scope: check all wagon-produced artifacts (existing and newly added), regardless of which file represents them; do not limit the check to changed manifest entries.
